03
Dress code

          

            
Semi-formal. Wear whatever makes you feel wonderful, in any colour except two.

            

              Please avoid
              
WhiteBlackJeans

            

            
We’ll be on the grass all night, so we recommend leaving the heels at home. Flats, sandals or boots are perfect. Bring something warm for after dark, especially if you’re camping.

          

        

        
Next Good to know 

      

    

  


  
  

    

      

      

        

          
04
Good to know

          

            
Where do I park?
On the grass inside the front gate. Someone will wave you to a spot.

            
Can we camp overnight?
Yes, please do. There’s room to camp on the property, so bring a tent or swag, bedding and something warm. Let us know on your reply so we can plan the space.

            
Not camping?
There are B&Bs and cottages nearby and up on Tamborine Mountain, and October is a busy month, so book early. Taxis and rideshare are hard to find out this way late at night, so plan your ride ahead.

            
What shoes should I wear?
Please skip the heels. We’re on the grass all night, so flats, sandals or boots are best. Bring a wrap for after sunset.

            
Can I bring a plus-one or the kids?
If your invitation includes a plus-one or children, it will say so on the invite.

            
Dietary requirements?
Tell us on your reply and we’ll pass it on to the caterers.

            
Gifts?
Your company is the loveliest gift. If you’d like to give something, there will be a wishing well on the night.
